title: Agricultural mapping
lede: Drone mapping of fields and crops, including vegetation indices when needed.
intro: Agricultural drone mapping provides an up-to-date image of the field, and a vegetation index such as NDVI can be added when the sensor and the question call for it.
Sensor type, timing and the kind of map are set according to the crop and the question being asked. No field results or case studies are listed here.
deliverables: A vegetation-index map (for example NDVI) when required
A seasonal series of maps, if needed
uses: Supporting irrigation or nutrition decisions as part of a wider process

side.title: Talk about a field
side.text: Share the crop, the field size and the kind of map you need.
